_comment: HKU WEIGHTING-n footnote pools that the formula-text scrape references ("with WEIGHTING n") but does not DEFINE — the pool composition lives in a separate PDF footnote box, VLM-read 2026-07 from Reference(2025)/HKU/"HKU 2025 Requirements & 2024 Weighting & Admission Score.pdf" (content header: "HKU 2025 Admissions Information for Programmes with Subject Weightings"). parse_hku_formula_weights sees the reference but had no pool -> best_of empty / weights incomplete. Applied by unify after the HKU block. HKU formula is stable across the cycle unless the source formula_2025/2026 differ, so 2025 pools mirror to 2026 only when 2026 keeps the weighting.

JS6224._note: Applied AI. formula_2025 "2xEng+2xMath+2xM1/M2+Best 2 with WEIGHTING 7"; WEIGHTING7 = x1.5 best-2 of {Bio,Chem,ICT,Phys}. NOTE formula_2026 is "Eng+Math+Best 3" (HKU DROPPED the weighting for 2026) so the pool is 2025-only.

JS6999._note: Computing and Data Science. formula_2025 "Eng+1.5xMath+Best 2 with WEIGHTING 8+Best Subject"; WEIGHTING8 = x1.5 best-2 of {Bio,Chem,Econ,ICT,M1,M2,Phys}. 2026 formula "Eng+Math+Best 3" dropped it -> 2025-only.

JS6602._note: Innovation and Technology. formula_2025 "2xEng+2xMath+Best 4 with WEIGHTING 10"; WEIGHTING10 = x2 {Bio,Chem,CombSci,DAT,ICT,IntSci,Phys,Tech&Living} and x1.5 {ALL other subjects}. The scrape captured the x2 pool but not the x1.5 floor (and left M1/M2 at x2 though they are NOT in the x2 pool). Full explicit map below (x2 heavy pool + Eng/Math; x1.5 on every other Cat-A/M1/M2/Chinese/Cat-C).

JS6274._note: BA Global Creative Industries (new for 2025). Booklet p1 (visually verified 2026-07-13): plain '2 x Eng + Best 4 Subjects' with NO weighting badge, and the WEIGHTING 1 box names only 6054 BA & 6286 BA(HDT). HKU added Chinese x1.5 FOR 2026 ('with Weighting1', subject_weight 'X 1.5: Chinese Language'); the scrape leaked it back onto 2025. The 33/32 median/LQ were scored without it.

JS6298._note: BA & BEng in AI and Data Science. Booklet p1: WEIGHTING 2 (x1.5 {Bio, Chem, Econ, ICT, M1 or 2, Phys}) badges the 'Best 2 Subjects' term ONLY — the trailing 'Best Subject' slot is unweighted, so at most TWO set-subjects carry x1.5. The API's flat subject_weight list over-weighted a third set-subject (up to ~+2.75). Same shape as JS6999's W8 -> count-2 pool. The 2026 formula is identical ('with weighting1'), so both years get the pool.

JS6107._note: Bachelor of Dental Surgery. Booklet p2: WEIGHTING 3 = x1.3 badging 'Best of Biology or Chemistry' — the ONE reserved slot; a student holding BOTH Bio and Chem gets x1.3 on the better one only (the flat map double-weighted both, ~+2.1 for a 5**/5* pair). The formula is 6 subjects (reserved slot + Best 5) — target count comes from the formula-text parse. Pool count-1 x1.3 + a compulsory pool forcing the reserved slot. 2026 formula identical ('with Weighting1', 'X 1.3: Biology / Chemistry').

add_calculation_constraints.description: Formula reserves one slot for the better of Biology / Chemistry

JS6688._note: Science Master Class. CORRECTED 2026-07-14 (user-reported, same class as JS6901): HKU's own calculator applies WEIGHTING 5 (x1.2 {Bio, Chem, M1 or 2, Phys}) to EVERY counted science subject, NOT just the trailing 'Best Subject'. The 2025 booklet badge visually sits on 'Best Subject', but HKU scores all these sciences x1.2 — consistent with the 2026 formula being flat x1.3 on the same set. The prior model (count-2 x1.0 + count-1 x1.2 pools) under-weighted a student's top two sciences. Encoded FLAT like JS6901/JS6119. Math (Compulsory Part) stays UNWEIGHTED in 2025 — it is NOT in the W5 set; the 2026 formula separately ADDED '1.3 x Math'. The compulsory pool forces the two reserved sciences into the Best-5.
JS6688.subject_weights_2025_raw: X 1.2: Biology / Chemistry / Mathematics Extended Part (Module 1 or 2) / Physics

add_calculation_constraints.description: Formula reserves two slots for the best two of: Biology, Chemistry, M1/M2, Physics

JS6901._note: Bachelor of Science. formula (both years) 'Eng + 1.5 x Math + 1.5 x Best Sci Subject(b) + Best 2 Subjects with WEIGHTING 6'. WEIGHTING 6 (2025 booklet p4) = x1.5 {Bio, Chem, M1 or 2, Phys} and applies to the BEST 2 slots, on top of the reserved Best-Sci slot — i.e. EVERY counted science subject gets x1.5, not just one (user-reported: Phys+Chem+M2 all x1.5 on HKU's own calculator; our single count-1 pool weighted only one, under-scoring ~5.5 pts). Encoded FLAT like JS6298's WEIGHTING 2, replacing the count-1 pool. Footnote b: the reserved slot itself is Bio/Chem/Phys only (not M1/M2) -> compulsory_subject_pool. 2026 formula identical ('with Weighting1', subject_weight 'X 1.5: Biology / Chemistry / Mathematics Extended Part (Module 1 or 2) / Physics').

add_calculation_constraints.description: Formula reserves one slot for the best science subject (Biology / Chemistry / Physics)

JS6119._note: BEd & BSc. Same structure as JS6901 with WEIGHTING 4 (2025 booklet p3) = x1.5 {Bio, Chem, M1 or 2, Phys} on the Best 2 slots; 2026 formula identical ('with Weighting1'). See JS6901 _note.
